name: Battle of Sagrajas/Zallaqa
summary: Almoravid Sultan Yusuf ibn Tashfin leads a Berber army from Morocco to assist the embattled taifa kings of al-Andalus against Alfonso VI of Castile-León, who had captured Toledo (1085). At Sagrajas (Zallaqa) near Badajoz, the Almoravids inflict a catastrophic defeat on Alfonso; it is the worst Christian defeat in the Reconquista for a generation. The Almoravids subsequently absorb the taifa kingdoms rather than withdrawing, transforming al-Andalus into an Almoravid province.

_quarry.structural_significance: Reverses the Reconquista's momentum for a generation; enables Almoravid absorption of al-Andalus; demonstrates the danger of inviting a more powerful outside force to resolve local military imbalances
